sources.title: Persian Last Names Dataset, over 10 million underlying records; source Latin name_english and original Persian name fields
sources.romanization_convention: Use source-published name_english paired with Persian-script source row, without inventing romanizations
sources.limitations: Publisher Latin mapping is not a uniform formal standard, with occasional errors; further audit needed
sources.expansion_selection: Preserve 489 original valid Latin surname values verbatim and at their original indices. Correct eleven literal English glosses wrongly recorded as name_english to country-attested Latin surname spellings from the pinned secondary Iranian list, with original Persian lexemes separately checked in the primary source. Append 2500 unique name_english candidates present in both Iran-specific datasets, excluding translated English glosses. No new arbitrary romanizations.

sources.title: Country IR 2019 surname-directory cross-attestation, Surname Dispersion Dataset (locatefamily.com crawl)
sources.license: MIT repository; upstream directory-data rights unverified
sources.romanization_convention: Prefer documented surname spellings present in both Persian-original/Latin primary corpus and Iran-specific Latin directory. Source-published literal English translations such as Farmer, Worker, Hunter are not Persian romanizations and are replaced only where the Iranian directory independently attests the corrected surname.
sources.selection: Additional 2500 all two-source-attested by exact diacritic/separator-insensitive Latin matching; retain publisher's Latin spellings and distinguish Persian original forms to avoid equivalent duplicated candidates. Original 11 gloss corrections explicitly enumerated above. Source ranks/frequencies discarded, selection uniform.
sources.limitations: Original corpus name_english has literal translations and inconsistent Persian romanizations. Eleven known glosses in the original 500 have been corrected, requiring explicit downstream review of historical prefix-preservation guards. Not a full human source audit or official national registry; source and redistribution rights require review.
